description: Mapping from Liu 2022 Structural_Class to CONTRIBUTING.md mechanism types

Diglycolamide (DGA).description: Neutral solvating extractants, DGA family with diglycolamide core structure

Aromatic ligand.description: Fallback for aromatic nitrogen heterocycles (BTP, BTBP). Requires SMARTS refinement via reclassify_extractant_types.py to distinguish Phenanthroline_Amide, Phenanthroline_Phosphonate, Pyridine_Bisamide, and Bipyridyl_Diamide subfamilies.

Phosphine oxide.description: Neutral organophosphorus extractants with P=O functional groups (pure P-donors only; phen+P hybrids are Phenanthroline_Phosphonate)

Other ligand.description: Miscellaneous extractants not fitting standard structural classes

dipicolinamide.description: Pyridine-2,6-dicarboxamide ligands; tridentate NNN coordination; flat/mixed REE selectivity

bis-triazinyl-phenanthroline.description: BTPhen family: 1,10-phenanthroline fused with bis-triazinyl groups; tetradentate NNNN coordination

pyridine-bisphosphonate.description: RESERVED for future ingestion. Pyridine-2,6-bisphosphonate ligands; tridentate NOP coordination; REVERSE REE selectivity (light REE preference). Complementary to Pyridine_Bisamide. Not yet present in v6 database.

notes: v0.2: Added 4 new extractant types (Phenanthroline_Amide, Phenanthroline_Phosphonate, Pyridine_Bisamide, Bipyridyl_Diamide) to distinguish aromatic scaffold subfamilies per paper taxonomy. Pyridine_Bisphosphonate reserved for future ingestion. Mechanisms defined per CONTRIBUTING.md.
